propositions: Read-only derivations over git history and working tree compute four code-health metrics: module-size distribution against a single flat cap, cap-change events, short-term churn, and refactor-to-addition ratio.
module_size_distribution scans src/rebar/**/*.py line counts against the cap from .github/module-size-limit.txt and returns count, near_cap_count, over_cap_count, max_loc.

cap_change_events, churn, and refactor_to_addition_ratio are computed deterministically from git log over a since/until range; churn returns insertions/deletions totals, ratio returns deletions/insertions or None when insertions is zero.
Each metric registers into the c085 registry via a single-arg context adapter compute that wraps the multi-arg raw function, with lens=code_health, source=git, confidence=high.
All four metrics (module_size_distribution, cap_change_events, churn, refactor_to_addition_ratio) are present in REGISTRY with correct labels and scanned against a fixture git repo in unit tests.
